title: ARCADE: EASIER FOR NEWCOMERS
why: His order for the Halloween party mode, build 10 of 20. In the arcade every hit on a player takes half, in both windows (on player 2 it stacks with kid mode). Every kill refunds half a magazine of the gun in hand, and every third kill of the run drops a Bandage into the backpack while the player carries fewer than 5 heals, shown on the pickup stack as KILL BONUS. The drop already gives 6 magazines and full armour. Normal raids are untouched.
now: In the arcade hits take half, every kill refunds half a magazine and every third kill adds a Bandage up to 5 heals.
